FLUIDLOVEBAND-LEAD.title: Lead
FLUIDLOVEBAND-LEAD.description: Alex on vocals and guitar. Adds a [gold]Lead[/gold] note to your Setlist. 3 Lead notes play a [gold]Lead Solo[/gold]: 10 damage to ALL enemies.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-RHYTHM.title: Rhythm
FLUIDLOVEBAND-RHYTHM.description: Toby on guitar and bass, plus the drum track. Adds a [gold]Rhythm[/gold] note to your Setlist. 3 Rhythm notes play a [gold]Rhythm Solo[/gold]: gain 10 [gold]Block[/gold].
FLUIDLOVEBAND-KEYS.title: Keys
FLUIDLOVEBAND-KEYS.description: Freddie on keyboard. Adds a [gold]Keys[/gold] note to your Setlist. 3 Keys notes play a [gold]Keys Solo[/gold]: draw 2 cards and gain 1 Energy.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-FLUID.title: Fluid
FLUIDLOVEBAND-FLUID.description: Changes role every turn: [gold]Lead[/gold], then [gold]Rhythm[/gold], then [gold]Keys[/gold], and round again. The Setlist bar shows which role Fluid cards play this turn.
